sets.title: Puzzle 1: 4 friends in a 4-storey building
sets.text:
4 friends (Rajesh, Naveen, Tarun, Ishita) live in a 4-storey building, one person on each floor. Floors are numbered 1 (lowest) to 4 (top). Conditions:
1. Tarun lives on a higher floor than Rajesh.
2. Ishita lives on the floor immediately above Naveen.
3. Naveen lives on the floor immediately above Rajesh.

sets.title: Puzzle 2: 4 friends in a 4-storey building
sets.text:
4 friends (Kavya, Ishita, Charan, Nisha) live in a 4-storey building, one person on each floor. Floors are numbered 1 (lowest) to 4 (top). Conditions:
1. Charan lives on floor 2.
2. Nisha lives on the floor immediately above Ishita.

sets.title: Puzzle 3: Stack of 4 coloured boxes
sets.text:
4 boxes of different colours (Red, Blue, White, Yellow) are stacked one above the other. Positions are counted from the bottom (position 1 is the lowest). Conditions:
1. The Blue box is placed somewhere above the Yellow box.
2. The White box is at position 3 from the bottom.
3. The White box is placed directly on top of the Blue box.

sets.title: Puzzle 4: Stack of 5 coloured boxes
sets.text:
5 boxes of different colours (Pink, Black, Yellow, Green, White) are stacked one above the other. Positions are counted from the bottom (position 1 is the lowest). Conditions:
1. The Yellow box and the Black box are placed next to each other in the stack.
2. The White box and the Green box are placed next to each other in the stack.
3. The Black box and the Green box are placed next to each other in the stack.
4. The Pink box is not at the bottom of the stack.
5. The Yellow box is placed somewhere above the White box.

sets.title: Puzzle 5: 5 friends in a 5-storey building
sets.text:
5 friends (Hema, Jagan, Suresh, Kavya, Karthik) live in a 5-storey building, one person on each floor. Floors are numbered 1 (lowest) to 5 (top). Conditions:
1. Kavya lives on the floor immediately above Hema.
2. Suresh lives on floor 4 or floor 1.
3. Karthik does not live on floor 3.
4. Karthik lives on the floor immediately above Jagan.

sets.title: Puzzle 6: 5 friends in a 5-storey building
sets.text:
5 friends (Venkat, Zoya, Kavya, Lakshmi, Bharat) live in a 5-storey building, one person on each floor. Floors are numbered 1 (lowest) to 5 (top). Conditions:
1. Exactly 3 floors separate the floors of Zoya and Bharat.
2. Bharat and Kavya live on adjacent floors.
3. Bharat does not live on floor 1.
4. Venkat does not live on floor 3.

sets.title: Puzzle 7: 5 friends in a 5-storey building
sets.text:
5 friends (Meera, Yamini, Chitra, Lakshmi, Prakash) live in a 5-storey building, one person on each floor. Floors are numbered 1 (lowest) to 5 (top). Conditions:
1. Lakshmi lives on floor 4.
2. Yamini lives on a higher floor than Meera.
3. Prakash and Yamini live on adjacent floors.
4. Prakash and Lakshmi live on adjacent floors.

sets.title: Puzzle 8: 5 friends in a 5-storey building
sets.text:
5 friends (Jagan, Mohan, Manoj, Priya, Bharat) live in a 5-storey building, one person on each floor. Floors are numbered 1 (lowest) to 5 (top). Conditions:
1. Manoj and Jagan live on adjacent floors.
2. Mohan does not live on the top floor.
3. Bharat lives on an even-numbered floor.
4. Exactly 3 floors separate the floors of Mohan and Manoj.

sets.title: Puzzle 9: 6 friends in a 6-storey building
sets.text:
6 friends (Manoj, Sunita, Bharat, Naveen, Karthik, Anitha) live in a 6-storey building, one person on each floor. Floors are numbered 1 (lowest) to 6 (top). Conditions:
1. Naveen lives on floor 2.
2. Sunita lives on the floor immediately above Anitha.
3. Anitha lives on the floor immediately above Naveen.
4. Manoj and Sunita live on adjacent floors.
5. Bharat lives on a higher floor than Karthik.

sets.title: Puzzle 10: 6 friends in a 6-storey building
sets.text:
6 friends (Karthik, Charan, Ishita, Chitra, Gayathri, Venkat) live in a 6-storey building, one person on each floor. Floors are numbered 1 (lowest) to 6 (top). Conditions:
1. Gayathri lives on the floor immediately above Chitra.
2. Chitra lives on floor 1.
3. Charan does not live on the top floor.
4. Karthik lives on a higher floor than Venkat.
5. Charan lives on an even-numbered floor.
6. Charan lives on the floor immediately above Ishita.

questions.questionText: Who lives on the topmost floor?
questions.explanation: Combining all the conditions gives a single arrangement (lowest to highest): floor 1: Rajesh; floor 2: Naveen; floor 3: Ishita; floor 4: Tarun. The top is Tarun.

questions.explanation: Combining all the conditions gives a single arrangement (lowest to highest): floor 1: Rajesh; floor 2: Naveen; floor 3: Ishita; floor 4: Tarun. The bottom is Rajesh.
